zh-Hans.promotional_text: 内置千问小模型，无需 API Key，在设备上离线解释选文、继续追问。支持悬浮助手和可调侧栏。AI 答案可能不准确或不完整，请核对原文。
zh-Hans.keywords: 阅读,电子书,离线,千问,文献,语境,笔记,高亮,书单,PDF,EPUB
zh-Hans.description:
DeepReader 是原生 iPhone 和 iPad 文档阅读器，把离线 AI 阅读助手放在正文旁边。

免费阅读与离线 AI
阅读和本机 AI 问答全部免费，无订阅或问答次数配额。书库可展示一条标注“广告”的内容，阅读页面不展示广告。广告需联网并按您的隐私选择展示；阅读和 AI 可离线使用。

内置模型，离线问答
应用内置 Qwen3 0.6B 量化小模型。选文解释和追问直接在设备上生成，无需账户、API Key、服务器、订阅或购买问答次数。模型随应用安装，不需要另行下载；阅读内容不会为 AI 推理上传到服务器。

边读边理解
长按选择词句，在半透明阅读助手中点击“解释选文”，并可继续追问。浮窗可拖动、收起或关闭，阅读位置保持不变。成功回答保存在本机历史，可回顾或主动分享。

调整阅读空间
宽屏可使用右侧 AI 栏，拖动分隔线调整正文和答案的空间，也可选择悬浮模式。窄屏自动使用浮窗，布局偏好保存在本机。

选择回答依据
可要求 AI 仅依据提供的书中文字，或结合模型已有的通用知识。两种模式都不联网搜索。选择“仅书中内容”也不能保证模型不会出错。

自己的阅读书库
从“文件”导入 PDF、EPUB、TXT 和 Markdown。支持搜索、高亮、阅读位置、评分和读完状态。PDF 可导出带高亮的副本；导入不会修改原文件。内置原创示例文章，打开即可体验。

答案可能不准确
AI 答案可能不准确、不完整或产生虚构信息，仅供辅助阅读。请核对原文，不要仅凭 AI 回答作出重要决定。小模型更适合简单词句释义，专业知识、复杂推理和计算可能不可靠。

使用限制
• 本机问答适用于短段落：最多取选文前 500 字、附近语境前 600 字；追问前 300 字及先前回答前 250 字。过长输入可能需要缩短，回答也有长度上限。
• 本版不提供全文总结。
• 应用约需 500 MB 存储空间；首次使用需初始化模型，生成时可能增加耗电和发热，速度取决于设备。
• EPUB 暂以纯文本章节显示，不显示原书排版和图片；Markdown 显示源文本，电子书搜索限当前章节。
• 不支持 DRM、MOBI/AZW3、Kindle KFX、扫描文件 OCR 或跨设备同步。
• 提供中文和英文界面。

DeepReader 是独立阅读器，不是模型开发者的官方产品。

en-US.promotional_text: Built-in Qwen powers offline reading explanations and follow-ups. No API key or AI purchases. AI answers may be inaccurate or incomplete; check the original text.
en-US.description:
DeepReader is a native iPhone and iPad document reader with an offline AI assistant beside your text.

Free reading and offline AI
Reading and on-device AI are free, with no subscriptions or question quota. One clearly labelled ad may appear in the library, never in the reader. Ads use a network connection and respect your privacy choices; reading and AI work offline.

Built-in, on-device AI
A quantized Qwen3 0.6B model is included in the app. Explanations and follow-ups are generated on your device without an account, API key, server, subscription or purchased question credits. No separate model download is required. Reading content is not uploaded for AI inference.

Understand as you read
Touch and hold to select a passage, then tap Explain in the translucent reading assistant. Ask follow-up questions without leaving your reading position. Drag, collapse or close the floating panel. Successful answers are saved in local History for review or optional sharing.

Adjust your reading space
On wide screens, use a right sidebar and drag its divider to resize the document and answer areas, or choose floating mode. Narrow screens use the floating panel automatically. Layout preferences are stored locally.

Choose an answer scope
Ask the model to use only the supplied book text, or allow its learned general knowledge. Neither mode searches the web. Book-only mode does not guarantee error-free answers.

Your own library
Import PDF, EPUB, TXT and Markdown from Files. Search, highlight, save reading positions, rate books and mark them finished. Export highlighted PDF copies while preserving the original. An original sample article is included for immediate use.

Answers may be inaccurate
AI answers may be inaccurate, incomplete or fabricated. They are reading aids: check the original text and do not rely solely on AI for important decisions. This small model is best suited to simple explanations; specialist knowledge, complex reasoning and calculations may be unreliable.

Limitations
• Short-passage Q&A uses up to the first 500 characters of a selection, 600 of nearby context, 300 of a follow-up and 250 of the previous answer. Long inputs may need shortening and answers have a length limit.
• Full-document summaries are not included in this version.
• Allow about 500 MB of storage. Initial model setup takes time. Generation may increase battery use and warmth; speed depends on the device.
• EPUB displays chapter text without original layout or images. Markdown displays source text. Ebook search covers the current chapter.
• DRM, MOBI/AZW3, Kindle KFX, scanned-document OCR and cross-device sync are unsupported.
• Chinese and English interfaces are included.

DeepReader is an independent reader, not an official product of the model developer.
